meta.usage: DressUpModel: SetUnit('player'); Undress(); then TryOn(id) per visible slot. Cape = Back slot. Robes (Clothes) cover Pants. Empty offHand = none (two-hand / ranged).
meta.verification: Every ID resolved by exact English name and checked against (a) QuestieDB data/Forever/foreverItemDB.lua (WoW: Forever item set, seeded from Classic Era 1.15.x) and (b) nexus-devs/wow-classic-items (Era) for slot + armor/weapon subtype + item set. Korean names from QuestieDB l10n/Forever/lookupItems/koKR.lua.

confidence.high: ID exists in the Forever item DB, English name matches, slot and armor/weapon type match
confidence.medium: exists but a slot/type/name check differed
